title: 札幌記念の後に・三つ眼はなくとも

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the protection of the deities of the north, Matikanefukukitaru makes her mark on the Sapporo Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterward, we go out on a fun sightseeing tour of Sapporo.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When we pass by the Sapporo Clock Tower, Matikanefukukitaru notices that the needle is pointing south towards the Nakayama Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Believing this to be a sign from above, she chooses to run in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She stokes her passion, determined to earn her spot on her own merits, unlike what happened with the Takarazuka Kinen.
